concurrency: Pure value construction; no shared mutable state.
inputs: caller clock domain, unit and value for source and observation
outputs: immutable clock value objects on records and in the manifest
purpose: Retain an explicit clock domain and a caller-declared unit/representation per source and observation value, keep ingestion order distinct from temporal and causal order, and perform no ambient wall-clock read, unit inference, random identity or cross-domain comparison, subtraction, sorting or conversion.
state: Owns no durable state; clock values are immutable normalized values carried with their records.

static_checks.expected: ast.parse succeeds for every planned path; no ambient-clock or cross-domain arithmetic call exists
static_checks.rule: python ast parse of the planned clocks source plus a check that no datetime.now/time.time/utcnow/cross-domain arithmetic or unit inference call exists
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

title: ARGUS2-SR-004-U unit specification - Explicit source and observation clock domains

unit_cases.expected: both clock values reconstruct with their exact domain, unit and value, unchanged by the read
unit_cases.precondition: an imported observation declaring distinct source and observation clock domains and caller units

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-CLOCK-MISSING; the value is not defaulted to an implicit domain
unit_cases.precondition: a clock value object with no domain identity

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-UNIT-MISSING; no unit is inferred
unit_cases.precondition: a clock value object with a domain but no declared unit/representation

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-NONFINITE; allow_nan=False canonical serialization is never bypassed
unit_cases.precondition: a clock value of NaN or Infinity

unit_cases.expected: records are returned in ingestion-ordinal order; neither timestamp is rescaled, subtracted, compared or sorted across domains
unit_cases.precondition: two records whose source and observation domains differ in unit and magnitude

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-CLOCK-UNRESOLVED reported; the unmapped relation stays explicit and is never inferred
unit_cases.precondition: a record requiring a clock mapping the caller did not declare

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-CLOCK-MISSING; absent means not declared and is never inferred
unit_cases.precondition: an observation-kind event appended with no clocks
unit_cases.stimulus: run.append_event(event_id='e1', producer_id='p1', event_kind='observation', observation=<valid projection record>)

unit_cases.precondition: open_run called with no caller clock
